victim_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Known to each other; prior enmity arising from an earlier altercation (neighbours/acquaintances)
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Not strangers: the deceased visited accused's house, prior altercation and enmity existed.

offence_category.quote: Murder by hitting with stone on head
offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under Section 302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.quote: upholding the conviction of the appellant under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code
statutory_provisions.reason: Section 302 IPC is the provision relied on; Exception 4 to s.300 was argued by defence only.

weapon.quote: caused the death of Surat Singh deceased with a stone

evidence_type.quote: Evidence of eye witnesses supporting the prosecution case
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence are both relied on; motive evidence also present.

confession.reason: The judgment says nothing about a confession, so 'None' is an assertion not made.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: the accused can be said to have caused the death by acting in a cruel manner
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Prior enmity, cruel manner and fatal injury on vital part are all identified by the court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are discussed in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the trial Court convicted and sentenced the appellant
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 and life imprisonment are supported by the judgment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Conviction under s.302 and life sentence affirmed (Criminal Appeal No. 158 of 2007, dated 17.11.2007)
high_court_outcome.quote: upholding the conviction of the appellant under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code and sentence to undergo life imprisonment
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence; 'Not applicable' contradicts this.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.quote: the accused has inflicted the fatal injury with a view to cause death

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed term; life imprisonment, so no years stated.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts as stated, but the medical opinion did not say injuries were inflicted with full force; that was the court's inference from the injury nature.
neutral_facts.quote: The medical report suggested that the injuries were inflicted with full force
neutral_facts.reason: Medical opinion only described the stone injury; 'full force' was the court's finding. Otherwise facts are accurate and neutral.

offence_severity.reason: Life imprisonment is the sentence imposed and upheld.

attempt_completion.quote: caused the death of Surat Singh deceased
attempt_completion.reason: Offence completed with death of the deceased.

physical_harm.quote: There are multiple wounds and the face is disfigured. The bones are pulverized.
physical_harm.reason: Multiple wounds, disfigurement, pulverized bones and fatal injury are described.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence (murder under s.302); the judgment does not say the appellant was 'charged' with one offence
number_of_offences.quote: the conviction of the appellant under Section 302
number_of_offences.reason: Single s.302 conviction is supported; the 'charged with one offence' wording is not stated.

financial_property_loss.reason: The judgment does not address property or financial loss.

premeditation_planning.reason: Intention to cause death is found, but the judgment does not use or find premeditation.

motive.reason: Previous enmity arising from earlier altercation is the motive accepted.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: Evidence of eye witnesses supporting the prosecution case and found reliable
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the evidence the courts accepted.

witness_credibility.quote: both the courts below have found the evidence of PW 3 Bahadur Singh and PW 4 Lakhi Ram to be reliable
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the courts' credibility findings on PW 2, 3, 4 and 7.
